entities.summary: Li Jinzhong, titled Wushang Khan, was a khan of the Khitans who, along with his brother-in-law Sun Wanrong, rose against the Wu Zhou dynasty in 696 and further invaded Wu Zhou territories. He died late in 696 and was succeeded by Sun.
